settings.overlay.autoHideWithLiveWindow: Ocultar con la ventana en vivo
settings.overlay.autoHideWithLiveWindowD: Cuando la ocultación automática de la ventana en vivo está activada, los overlays visibles se ocultan con el medidor en vivo y solo vuelven si estaban visibles antes.
settings.overlay.autoHideWithLiveWindowH: Sigue el ciclo de ocultar/mostrar del medidor en vivo basado en daño. No activa overlays por sí solo y permanece inactivo mientras Auto-hide Live Window esté apagado.
settings.overlay.skillCdAccelerationDesc: Adds a small acceleration badge and cooldown diagnostic tooltip to Skill CD icons. Useful for checking cooldown reduction and acceleration sources.
settings.overlay.subtitle: Control which monitor systems actively publish data to the shared overlay.
settings.profile.subtitle: Create and manage skill monitor profiles, and configure event logger behavior and session log storage.
settings.profile.autoHideWindowsOnGameBl: Ocultar live y overlays cuando el juego esté inactivo

Cuando este perfil está activo, el medidor live y los overlays visibles se ocultan mientras otra app tiene el foco y vuelven cuando Blue Protocol: Star Resonance o Resonance Logs - Global vuelve a estar activo. Solo comprueba la ventana en primer plano del sistema operativo y no lee la memoria del juego.
settings.profile.highlightDpsHealerSpecI: Smite y Dissonance se mantienen en verde de healer, con un brillo rojo opcional para marcar su rol de healer DPS en las filas live e historial.
settings.profile.restore8165RoseOrbsTool: Added option to restore 8165 orbs for players affected by scam. This option doesn't do anything. It's just here for the vibes. #NeverForget

settings.discordPresence.title: Discord Rich Presence
settings.discordPresence.description: Publish your current scene, boss, true DPS timer, personal DPS, and deaths to Discord when Discord is running.
settings.discordPresence.rateLimitToolti: Discord rate-limits Rich Presence updates, so Resonance Logs sends meaningful changes at a paced interval instead of every DPS tick. Combat and death updates are limited to about every 5 seconds, idle updates are slower, and duplicate states are skipped so Discord is less likely to ignore bursts.
settings.discordPresence.enabledDescript: Shows Resonance Logs activity in Discord while Discord is running. Presence is cleared when this is disabled.
settings.discordPresence.dpsMetricDescri: Choose whether Discord shows your DPS or true DPS.
